Shortly after, lightning would strike it, reviving it with 2,100 health and changing its name to ''Revived Frank''. }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Frankenstein''' was the first boss that appeared in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]], though only the first '''Frankenstein''' that spawns was considered a boss. It was a high-health, slow enemy that was immune to being completely stopped by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]], being only slowed down instead. Because it was a boss enemy, it was also immune to being frozen by freezing towers and being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], with an additional 35% defense. Additionally, on some waves, '''Frankenstein''' spawned as a hidden enemy. '''Frankenstein''' had one ability, where upon death it would come back to life by being struck by a lightning bolt. After it was reanimated, its health changed to 2,100, its name changed from ''Frankenstein'' to ''Revived Frank'' and it had blue and yellow electricity appear on it. ==Appearance== The '''Frankenstein''' was a large humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It had a lime green skin tone with dirt all over it, had a dark green torso, waist and pants. It wore a greenish-black coat with long sleeves and three grey buttons. It had one bolt on each shoulder, a thin metal beam going down each arm, two bolts sticking out of the sides of its head, short dark green hair and stitches with a red line under its hairline. On its first and second deaths, it would fall onto its back. After its first death, for its ''Reanimation'' ability, it would be struck by yellow lightning, causing it to rise back up and gain blue and yellow electricity particles across its body. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended against the '''Frankenstein'''. **Do note that, on later waves, some '''Frankensteins''' spawn as [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, so you will be required to bring a decent DPS tower to deal with them. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] can be quite useful at decreasing its defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. *When it first spawns on Wave 11, it is a boss enemy, therefore it cannot be frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]] or completely stopped by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. **This also means that it is unaffected by the [[Witch (Lunar Overture)|Witch]]'s ability. **After wave 11, '''Frankenstein''' is no longer a boss, reducing its immunities to only being immune to the [[Warden]]'s and [[Electroshocker]]'s stun, only being slowed down by them. ***As such, towers like the [[Sledger]] are strong options for dealing with '''Frankenstein''' past wave 11. *Be careful if '''Frankenstein''' gets very close to the end of the path, as you may not have enough time or damage to kill the '''Revived Frank'''. Thus, it is highly important to kill them as soon as possible. This enemy requires a total of 4,900 damage to successfully be defeated. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FrankensteinWalk.gif|Walking animation (31 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) FrankensteinDeath.gif|Death animation (31 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) FrankensteinRevive.gif|''Reanimation'' animation (31 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) }} ==Trivia== *Contrary to common belief, '''Frankenstein''' is the erroneous term to call the monster. As stated in the original 1818 novel ''Frankenstein'', the monster is actually called Frankenstein's Monster or the Creature, while Dr. Frankenstein is the creator of the monster. **This enemy may be purposely called '''Frankenstein''' as a reference to the common misconception. *In the original novel, the monster is revived using electricity. The lightning bolt that turned the '''Frankenstein''' into the '''Revived Frank''' may be a reference to this. *As the '''Frankenstein''' died twice, when it received a pumpkin hat on its head, it would drop {{Pumpkins|Pumpkins}} two times instead of the usual one. *The '''Frankenstein''' and [[Abomination]] are the only enemies that can revive themselves after being killed, though the [[Abomination]] is the only one that is still in the game. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]g **'''Frankenstein''' added. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Frankenstein''' removed. ==Notes== {{TheHauntedPast|[[Giant Skeleton (Lunar Overture)|Giant Skeleton]]|Wave 9|Frankenstein|Wave 11|[[Clown (Lunar Overture)|Clown]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Frankenstein}}
